name: Kleines Bauernherrenhaus
prompt:
Create ONE transparent Inkarnate worldmap stamp of a small rural manor house.

Use the attached APPROVED ROUND GAELIC FARMHOUSE as the PRIMARY STYLE REFERENCE. Match its playful simplicity, chunky rounded proportions, slightly wonky hand-drawn dark-brown outlines and restrained flat watercolor coloring as closely as possible. Other references define the subject or architecture only. Keep exactly this SMALL MAP SYMBOL level of detail even though the output canvas is larger. This is a tiny charming atlas doodle, drawn with a few confident pen strokes and simple watercolor fills.

Subject: One modest L-shaped cream-plastered farmhouse with two broad blue-grey roof shapes, a crooked wooden door and three tiny dark windows. Rural family home, no battlements or palace ornament.. Reduce the subject to a few large, clear, slightly irregular shapes. For buildings, favor cozy, chubby proportions, generous simple roofs, almost plain walls and very few doors or windows. Adapt the architecture to the requested motif while retaining the approved cartoonish drawing language. Use the same gently elevated three-quarter map angle as the approved reference. Only a handful of short material marks. Dark-brown outlines carry the design. Warm muted natural colors, gentle paper grain inside the colored shapes only. Two flat tonal values per material, very little shading.

Show ONLY the requested stamp and indispensable attached elements. No extra props or scenery. No individually rendered stones, planks, straw fibers or shingles. No intricate cracks, weathering spots, elaborate ornament, realistic surface rendering or 3D lighting. No extra detail invented to fill the large canvas. Prioritize the simple playful reference shapes above all else. Do not copy the farmhouse subject when another motif is requested.

Entire motif visible, comfortable transparent margin. TRUE transparent PNG alpha background; Alpha = 0 outside the motif and in open gaps. No ground patch, scenery, shadow, colored backdrop, paper rectangle, pin frame, text, white outline or halo.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a newly drawn small-place marker for Tirfelyn farm, to remain clear at 32–48 pixels. One square 1:1 PNG. Keep the actual motif large within a modest transparent margin. This is new artwork, not a copy of an existing marker. No teardrop, circular badge, pin frame, labels or text.
